summary: This informational document describes a framework and reference model for the Interface to Network Security Functions (I2NSF). Network security functions are packet-processing engines, such as firewalls, that inspect and optionally modify traffic. The framework describes the major components needed to let security functions be requested and configured through standard interfaces, including in virtualized environments.

eli5.summary: A school has many different guards. This describes one common way to give any guard instructions, no matter which company made the guard.

questions: how to configure network security functions through a standard interface
